summary: Iter-14: Verified country-adaptive landing + info-request flow for VozLeads. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed on /api/public/geo and /api/public/info-request (MX phone normalization to +525512345678, FR country 422 Spanish message with 'Latinoamérica', DO 809/829/849 enforcement, short-number 422, consent=false 400, 3 req/IP/10min rate-limit → 429) plus landing.MAX_SECONDS==15, GREETING template, countries.norm_demo_phone, and vapi.build_assistant adding endCallPhrases=['hasta luego'] only when max_seconds<=20. Frontend: used Playwright contexts with distinct timezone_id to simulate visitor countries. On tz Europe/Madrid /: hero-eyebrow='🇪🇸Línea operativa en España (+34)', hero-flag=🇪🇸, pricing in €, no pricing-currency-switch, form prefix=+34 default ES. On tz America/Santiago /: hero='🇨🇱Línea operativa en Chile (+56)', pricing $49.000 CLP, no 'España' in visible text (only 'Chile'), form default CL +56. On tz America/Mexico_City /: hero='🇲🇽Muestra gratuita para México', solicitar-country-select default MX, prefix +52, EUR pricing, options list = 18 Spanish-speaking countries (ES, CL + LatAm; no FR/DE/PT). On tz America/Lima: 🇵🇪 Perú equivalent. On tz Europe/Berlin (INT): generic eyebrow 'Agente de voz en español', no hero-flag. Fixed pages: /es (from CL tz) renders ES-only, solicitar-country-select has single option 'ES' and is disabled, no visible 'Chile' in body. /cl (from ES tz) renders CL-only with CLP, no visible 'España'. /mx renders with form default MX, prefix +52, EUR. SEO topic pages /call-center-con-ia, /central-telefonica-con-ia, /telefono-con-ia all return 200 with proper h1.

ui_bugs.issue: On /mx (and likely /ar, /co, /pe, /ec, /uy, /ve, /pa, /cr, /gt, /hn, /sv, /ni, /do, /bo, /py) when the visitor's tz resolves to ES or CL, the eyebrow renders Spain/Chile's 'Línea operativa en España (+34)' line with the LatAm country flag (e.g. 🇲🇽 flag + Spanish line). Because useMarket treats pageCountry != ES/CL as not fixed, m.market falls back to the geo market (ES/CL), so Hero shows m.t.line instead of a MX-specific eyebrow. Visitor from a different tz (e.g. Berlin/INT) does see the correct 'Muestra gratuita para México' eyebrow. Spec expects LatAm country pages to always present themselves as that country.

ui_bugs.component: InfoForm country-select on home '/' for ES/CL visitors
ui_bugs.issue: When the auto-detected market is ES or CL on home '/', the select still exposes all 18 Spanish-speaking countries as <option> values (incl. 'Chile' on tz Madrid, 'España' on tz Santiago). They are not visually shown while the <select> is collapsed, but they are DOM text nodes. Spec says tz Europe/Madrid / should have no visible 'Chile' anywhere incl. footer; strictly interpreted this includes option labels. Suggest treating ES/CL market as fixed for list filtering (list = m.market==='ES'||'CL' ? only that country : DEMO) so Madrid visitors only see 🇪🇸España in the dropdown.

action_items: Fix Hero eyebrow on country-type pages (/mx, /ar, /co, /pe, /ec, /uy, /ve, /pa, /cr, /gt, /hn, /sv, /ni, /do, /bo, /py): make them render a country-specific line (e.g. 'Muestra gratuita para <país>' or page.eyebrow) regardless of the visitor's detected market. Likely fix inside useMarket: treat page.type==='country' with country in DEMO as fixed, or in Hero branch unconditionally use page.eyebrow / visitor-based text when page.country is a LatAm country.

(Optional) Limit the InfoForm country list to just [ES] or [CL] when m.market === 'ES' or 'CL' and page is '/' (home), so that visibly-rendered <option>s do not contain 'Chile' on the Spanish site and vice versa. Keeps 18-country list only for INT market.
No backend action items — all /api/public/info-request validations, rate-limit, phone normalization, and demo greeting/length limits behave per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: landing.info_request correctly caps leads: INTL_DAILY_CAP=40, MAX_SECONDS=15, GREETING ends with '¡Hasta luego!' matching vapi.build_assistant's endCallPhrases.
vapi.build_assistant conditionally adds endCallPhrases=['hasta luego'] only when lead.max_seconds<=20 — good defensive guard for demo calls.
countries.norm_demo_phone enforces DO prefixes 809/829/849 correctly and strips leading zeros; MX normalization verified against +525512345678.
InfoForm.useEffect re-syncs country only when phone is empty — prevents overwriting user input, good UX.

Potential UX nit: on country-type pages like /mx, Hero.useMarket falls back to geo market for non-ES/CL pageCountry, which contradicts the SEO intent of a MX-dedicated page when the visitor is from Spain or Chile. Hero.eyebrow should prefer page-level identity for country-type pages.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — core geo adaptation, pricing currency, flags, fixed /es|/cl, SEO topic pages all correct; 2 minor inconsistencies around hero eyebrow on country pages and dropdown options on home.

seed_data_creation: Created 6+ info_requests across test IPs 203.0.113.x for rate-limit & validation coverage (prefixed with 'Test' / 'RL User' names).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use Playwright browser.new_context(timezone_id='Europe/Madrid'|'America/Santiago'|'America/Mexico_City'|'America/Lima'|'Europe/Berlin') to simulate geo without needing the CF header. In preview /api/public/geo returns {country:''} (no Cloudflare), so the tz fallback in geo.jsx is the only signal. On country-type pages (/mx etc.) the Hero eyebrow follows the visitor's market, not the page — if main agent fixes this, re-run the Playwright matrix above (should show 'Muestra gratuita para México' with 🇲🇽 regardless of tz). Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_vozlead_iter14.py is self-contained (loads /app/backend/.env in-process) and can be re-run with: python -m pytest tests/test_vozlead_iter14.py -v.
rca of the issue: Hero country-page issue RCA: in /app/frontend/src/lib/geo.jsx `useMarket`, `fixed = pageCountry === 'ES' || 'CL'`. For pageCountry='MX', fixed=false, so market = geo-detected ES/CL/INT. In Sections.jsx Hero: `{m.market === 'INT' ? (m.visitor ? 'Muestra gratuita para '+visitor.name : page.eyebrow) : m.t.line}`. When market is ES/CL (visitor from Spain/Chile viewing /mx), it renders m.t.line (ES/CL line) with visitor.flag=MX from `byCode(fixed ? pageCountry : local ? pageCountry : geo.country)` → MX. Fix: in Hero, prefer `page.eyebrow` or `Muestra gratuita para ${visitor.name}` whenever page.type==='country' and page.country is a LatAm DEMO code, OR treat such pages as 'fixed' in useMarket.
